item.text: [{"task_id":"9f5f939b","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    fg = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    mark = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    start = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    axes = [[int(round(v)) for v in row] for row in params['axes']]","    signs = [int(round(v)) for v in params['signs']]","    out = grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            if grid[r, c] != bg:","                continue","            matched = True","            for dr, dc in axes:","                found = False","                for distance in range(max(0, start), max(h, w)):","                    good = True","                    for sign in signs:","                        for offset in (distance, distance + step):","                            rr = r + sign * offset * dr","                            cc = c + sign * offset * dc","                            if rr < 0 or rr >= h or cc < 0 or cc >= w:","                                good = False","                            elif grid[rr, cc] != fg:","                                good = False","                    if good:","                        found = True","                        break","                if not found:","                    matched = False","                    break","            if matched:","                out[r, c] = mark","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[5],"axes":[2,2],"signs":[2]},"params":{"rule":[8,1,4,2,1],"axes":[[1,0],[0,1]],"signs":[-1,1]},"rationale":"Mark background cells yellow where two vertical blue dominoes lie symmetrically above and below, and two horizontal blue dominoes lie symmetrically left and right.
